translations.1: Early morning, the mist outside the mountain gate hasn't dissipated yet.
translations.12: Wanqi Jining stroked his head, then turned and ran towards the foot of the mountain.
translations.13: 解玄站在殿门口，剑尚未拔出，但灯光却突然熄灭了一瞬间。
translations.14: Elder Qin, how are you? I came on behalf of the Master to collect one-third of the spirit stones.
translations.15: Three-fifths? The spiritual stones were accumulated by the sect, when should outsiders come to take them?
translations.16: The barriers have been broken, the spiritual stones are not safe in your hands. In three days, I will come back.
translations.17: 解玄冷笑一声，转身便走，头也不回。
translations.18: Saying something three days ago is the same as saying it today, and I never break my promises.
translations.19: Elder Qin stroked his beard and looked at the sleeping Ms. Chou on the mat.
translations.2: Yunzhou, you've finally returned. Did you bring enough Ling Stones?
translations.20: 长老，请让我去守卫结界。仇姑娘有乐川照看，我可以走了。
translations.21: 终于，点了点头，从袖中取出一枚玉符。
translations.22: This is the Eye of the Storm command. By guarding it, you will protect your path.
translations.23: Lechuan put the medicine pouch into Yunzhou's arms, and then quietly reminded him of a few things.
translations.24: At the entrance to the mountain, Wanqi Jing delivered a蓑衣 (蓑衣 -蓑衣).
translations.25: Thank you, Wanqi Senior Brother. Tell @仇姑娘 (仇姑娘 -仇姑娘) to thank me.
translations.26: 单云舟点了点头，把阵眼令收好。
translations.27: In the room, @仇霜 slowly opened her eyes.
translations.28: 醒就好。你昏了一整天，不要乱动
translations.29: 仇霜费力地坐起来，看向窗外裂开的天幕。
translations.3: Brought three bags, all from the best sources in the mountains.
translations.30: 没有人注意到，信封上盖着解玄的印。
translations.4: The barrier cracked again last night, and Elder Qin didn't sleep at all.
